description: Crash data from Queensland roads is a dataset listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Road Safety Data (National Road Safety Hub) group, published by Transport and Main Roads, Qld. Location and characteristics of crashes within Queensland for all reported Road Traffic Crashes 1 January 2001 to 31 December 2023, (property damage only crashes to 31 December 2010). Coverage is Queensland, 2021 to 2023; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as annual, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2025-03-20. Files and pages listed: CSV (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support road incident and emergency response analysis and capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
